messages:
ryan: hey all, new hire here — first PR but CI failed during docker pull step. PR: https://github.com/redwood/example/pull/130
ryan: buildkite log shows: 
```
Step: docker pull registry.redwood.internal/redwood/base:latest
Error response from daemon: unauthorized: authentication required
failed to fetch image: exit status 1
```
maya: welcome @ryan! are you using an internal runner or cloud agents? unauthorized on registry usually means the agent doesn't have credentials or the registry token expired.
ryan: looks like cloud agents per the job: runner "cloud-eu-2". i haven't touched registry creds. this is my first time pushing a branch though.
infra-oncall: hey @ryan — quick context: we recently rotated the registry CI token and only rolled it to the pool in us regions. some EU cloud agents still have the old secret cached. i'll cordon the affected pool and requeue your job.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/build" started for PR #130 (job id: bk-13130).
jen: @infra-oncall FYI we should update the onboarding doc so new hires know where the registry creds live (vault path and who to ping).
infra-oncall: agreed. requeued to cloud-eu-3 which has updated secret. re-run id bk-13131.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/build" started for PR #130 (job id: bk-13131).
ryan: thanks — re-run looks like it's pulling now.
buildkite-bot: docker pull step succeeded (image pulled from registry.redwood.internal) for job bk-13131 ✅
buildkite-bot: pipeline "redwood-ci/build" finished for PR #130 (job id: bk-13131) — passed ✅
ryan: merged! thanks everyone, lesson learned about region-specific token rolls :)
maya: welcome aboard @ryan :tada: i'll add a short note to the onboarding checklist about checking the registry token rollout and who to ping.
infra-oncall: follow-up: i'll create a small runbook and schedule a token roll automation next week so this doesn't recur. if you see similar in future, ping #eng-infra-runner and include the runner name in the log.
